snippet.title: Features Overview #2: Combat and Progression | Crimson Desert
snippet.description:
In the second Features Overview video, learn what it means to fight like a Greymane. From weapons to chaining skills, we look at how combat works in Crimson Desert. This episode will also cover how you'll unlock skills, upgrade equipment, face the threats of Pywel, and grow into a formidable fighter.
(The footage in this video was captured on PC.)

00:36 Fighting Like a Greymane
3:03 The Path to Progression

Pre-order Crimson Desert:
» Steam: https://pearlabyss.info/steam_featured_en
» PlayStation Store: https://pearlabyss.info/ps_featured_en 
» Xbox Store: https://pearlabyss.info/xb_featured_en 
» Epic Games Store: https://pearlabyss.info/epic_featured_en

About Crimson Desert  
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Pearl Abyss. A devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent. The Greymane Kliff is determined to reunite with his surviving comrades and rebuild what was lost. But on a journey where alliances are forged, dangers abound, and mysterious factions are uncovered, Kliff comes to realize that an unprecedented threat and a destiny greater than he imagined await him. 

RECLAIM POWER. REACH BEYOND.
The fight for Pywel begins on March 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, Mac, and Epic Games Store. 

Join the official Crimson Desert channels and stay updated!
